question.text: The T+3 timeline for listing after closure of public issue is applicable for all public issues opening on or after:

explanation.text: The Logic: The T+3 listing timeline applies to all public issues opening on or after December 1, 2023. The Trap: The other dates do not match the workbook's stated effective date for the T+3 listing requirement. Note: The UPI/ASBA mechanism reduced the time from issue closure to listing by up to 3 working days, enabling the move to the T+3 listing timeline.
